description: United States coverage across 50 published drives today; strongest in the West and Southwest, with coverage growing in waves. Plan a U.S. road trip and find stops along the way within a 15, 30, or 60 minute detour budget. Optionally exclude stop categories. Published endpoint pairs use their stored route; other pairs use a bounded live lookup or return published alternatives when unavailable. Returns planning links, not bookings or live navigation.
